title and abstract.summary: The study investigated how mining activities affect the functional beta diversity of Ephemeroptera nymphs, testing whether pre-served streams have higher functional beta diversity than altered streams and if environmental variation is the main predictor of functional beta diversity.

results.summary: This study measured the functional beta diversity of Ephemeroptera communities across altered and preserved stream environments in the Carajás National Forest. The measurements covered multiple genera within the order Ephemeroptera. This study measured the total functional beta diversity, turnover, and nestedness components for Ephemeroptera across different sites, examining the influence of environmental variables and spatial factors. The study measured functional beta diversity, turnover, and nestedness for the functional dissimilarity of Ephemeroptera in the Carajas National Forest.
